name: ghostly_figure
description: at the far end of the hall, near the portrait, you catch a glimpse of something in your peripheral vision. a young girl in a white nightgown, standing perfectly still. when you turn to look directly, she's gone.

params.success_message: where the figure stood, you find a small, cold spot on the floor. a single white feather lies there, untouched by dust. you pick it up — it's real.
